from scipy.optimize import least_squares

def handcloud(o):
    pts=[]
    for c in cams:
        p=cloud(o,c); im=o.last[c].astype(float)
        mask=(p[:,:,2]>.63)&(p[:,:,2]<.93)&(p[:,:,1]<.245)&(p[:,:,1]>-.25)&(np.max(im,2)-np.min(im,2)<45)&(np.min(im,2)>95)
        pts.append(p[mask])
    return np.concatenate(pts)

def icp(a,b,init=None,iters=50,cut=.03):
    T=np.eye(4) if init is None else init.copy(); tree=cKDTree(b)
    for i in range(iters):
        ap=a@T[:3,:3].T+T[:3,3]; d,ind=tree.query(ap)
        keep=d<cut
        x=ap[keep]; y=b[ind[keep]]
        mx=x.mean(0); my=y.mean(0)
        u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd((x-mx).T@(y-my)); rot=vt.T@u.T
        if np.linalg.det(rot)<0: vt[-1]*=-1; rot=vt.T@u.T
        tr=my-rot@mx
        T[:3,3]=rot@T[:3,3]+tr; T[:3,:3]=rot@T[:3,:3]
        if np.linalg.norm(tr)<1e-7 and np.linalg.norm(rot-np.eye(3))<1e-6: break
    d,_=tree.query(a@T[:3,:3].T+T[:3,3]); return T,np.sqrt(np.mean(np.sort(d)[:int(.85*len(d))]**2))

def skew(v):
    x,y,z=v; return np.array([[0,-z,y],[z,0,-x],[-y,x,0]])

def exp_screw(s,theta):
    w=s[:3]; v=s[3:]; a=np.linalg.norm(w); wn=w/a; ang=theta*a; W=skew(wn)
    T=np.eye(4); T[:3,:3]=R.from_rotvec(w*theta).as_matrix()
    V=np.eye(3)*ang+(1-np.cos(ang))*W+(ang-np.sin(ang))*W@W
    T[:3,3]=V@v/a
    return T

def log_screw(T,theta):
    w=R.from_matrix(T[:3,:3]).as_rotvec(); a=np.linalg.norm(w); W=skew(w/a)
    V=np.eye(3)*a+(1-np.cos(a))*W+(a-np.sin(a))*W@W
    v=np.linalg.solve(V,T[:3,3])*a
    return np.r_[w,v]/theta
